question: What is the FAST-DS foreign asset disclosure scheme threshold and tax rate?
ground_truth: The Foreign Asset Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS) has two eligibility buckets: (1) Foreign assets value up to Rs 1 crore - pay 10% tax on undisclosed income; (2) Foreign assets value above Rs 1 crore - pay 15% tax on undisclosed income. Both require filing Schedule FA in ITR and payment by 31 Dec 2024.
